semantic.justification: Owns ODT package-stream import ordering for the required mimetype, manifest, styles.xml, content.xml, and meta.xml streams with ZIP/XML resource ceilings. Encryption, ZIP64, signatures, and absent or malformed mandatory streams are rejected before document replacement. Task177 implements actual plain OASIS ManifestExport over reused PropertyValue/Any/OUString and native comphelper AttributeList plus erased SAX method contracts. Preserve root scan early completion,16OASIS MIME choices,lexical version thresholds,source property/attribute/event order,nonempty entry versions,int64 Size,failed Any extraction destinations,duplicates and retained list values. Worker-safe browser SAX composition serializes exact attribute character values without DOM or a fabricated native Writer service. Writer supplies its own stream/font policy to the same exporter;the removed Writer-only shared export helper has no compatibility alias. Existing Writer import validation stays explicitly bounded pending native ManifestImport;full generic import,encrypted/legacy export,UNO ABI/services and complete ODS document/model/UI remain pending. Immutable native MIME literal contents use JS strings at browser/package boundaries;GC owns physical AttributeList objects and existing OUString/Any value semantics are reused without a new lifetime framework. Extracted actual ODS fixture manifest metadata is checked separately from its ZIP64 package and is not a document round trip or claimed native QA suite port. Whole-class/module parity stays unverified. Task178 implements actual plain ManifestImport namespace/validity scopes,fixed native property slots and real PropertyValue/Any output plus ManifestReader SAX-failure empty-result behavior. Existing SAL signed64 parser is reused through missing terminated C and const OUString entry points,including embedded-zero termination and exact overflow behavior. Source-owned plain ZipPackage metadata/MIME fallback/conflict and ZipPackageFolder consistency operate on actual ZipFile catalogs with real stream/folder properties;no storage/service class is fabricated. Preserve duplicate metadata application,first Version fallback,unknown namespace/invalid-parent leniency and recursive folder assignment with first-true early exit;CALC162..163 remain preserved and CALC-164 is withdrawn;native unordered binary bucket order is not simulated. Writer uses the shared reader and native absent-stream early returns with actual SwDoc defaults;remove the noncanonical mandatory Standard-definition guard and adapt font existence checks to actual applied stream metadata. Retire the duplicated Writer-only shared manifest validator without a compatibility alias. Existing ZIP32,depth/declaration/XML-byte admission bounds remain explicit. Encryption,writable storage/full UNO parser/stream/component services,complete Calc document/UI/same-model ODS remain pending;physical memory/refcount/cache machinery is not added and broad parity stays unverified. RTF113. Reads the optional standard configuration stream for packed and browser ODF packages. Original ZipFile Checks modes retain exact duplicate rejection, ASCII-only case collisions and the first retained entry decision for TryCheckInsensitive, including empty mimetype AutoCorrect behavior after FAT-directory filtering. OOXML ZipStorage selects CheckInsensitive; Writer/Calc ODF byte entry points select TryCheckInsensitive, matching ZipPackage StorageFormat routing. The actual OUString lowercase path delegates to rtl_uString_newToAsciiLowerCase and original newReplaceChars allocation/assign/release logic with reused native CaseReplace and SAL character helpers. Unchanged strings alias data; conversions preserve UTF16/embedded-zero/non-ASCII units and release old destination after copying. No Unicode locale folding, path normalization or fake model/storage/service owner is introduced. Flat transport/resource/error boundaries and incomplete native package/storage/output/model/filter/Worker/UI acceptance remain explicit; physical pointer/ABI/allocator/thread guarantees remain unverified.
